### One Stick in God's Hand
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/one-stick-gods-hand
Passage: Ezekiel 37:19
Points:
- Ezekiel joins two inscribed sticks representing Judah and Joseph/Ephraim to portray the reunification of the divided kingdom.
- The object lesson promises that God will gather His scattered people and restore them to life in His presence.
- The blessings of this restored kingdom belong to those who display persevering faith and obedience under the Davidic King, Jesus Christ.
- Reclaiming northern tribes lost among foreign nations foreshadows God calling Gentiles to faith in Christ.
- While the visible church contains both true and nominal believers, God alone knows the invisible church of genuine followers.
